name: bb
description: Builder Bundle (bb): the unified skill set for Inspira builders, 19 skills (Pensar, Desenhar, Construir, Revisar, Design, Pesquisar/Doc trilhas, plus /bb:profile, /bb:reel and /bb:animate-tour), invoked as /bb:<skill> (e.g. /bb:spec). It never merges on its own: a merge happens only when the person allows it, under the repository's rules, and landing on a protected branch stays with the human. Its operating context lives in ~/.claude/BUILDER-BUNDLE.md, imported by the person's CLAUDE.md and carrying the profile calibrated once by /bb:profile, which also deletes both when the person wants nothing from bb in their sessions.
